name: What factors influence the cost of drywall installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of drywall installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of drywall installation is influenced by several factors. These include the total square footage of walls and ceilings, the type of drywall chosen (e.g., standard, moisture-resistant, fire-rated), the complexity of the project (e.g., high ceilings, many corners, arches), and the level of finish required (e.g., Level 3 for basic paint, Level 5 for high-gloss paint). Material costs, labor rates, and whether old drywall needs to be removed and disposed of also contribute to the overall expense.
acceptedAnswer.description: Factors influencing cost include square footage, drywall type, project complexity, desired finish level, materials, and labor.
